notes.title: Africa and South America added to Guess the Flag
notes.content:
Almost every morning I draw a few flags for the Guess the Flag game and now Africa and South America are added! Do you know more flags than your friend? Only Asia left to add what I am working on at the moment. 

I also upload a little short on YouTube almost every day about little projects I am working on including timelapses of some of the drawings for Better With A Friend. 

Thank you for supporting and playing! And have some small and big ideas I want to incorporate this year. 

- Geert

notes.title: Better With A Friend part of the Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990659/d8f57fec309746302f6ab6d48d421831e8097c36.png[/img]

[b]Better With A Friend is part of the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest! [/b]To celebrate this you can get this evolving collection of hand drawn mini games for the Steam Deck to play together for 40% off! Also don't forget there is a special bundle where you will also get the 2024 Sketchbook as a PDF. 

While I am also working on another small game (and it will have special Steam Deck controls) there will still be small games, trivia questions and other things added this year! Tomorrow more contintens will be added to Guess the Flag.

Thank you everyone for the support and I hope you are enjoying the mini games with a friend (or make friends with them). 

- Geert

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/geertverhoeff][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44990659/aa011e494763f43dc55004ab2729cdca7eefc60f.png[/img][/url]

tags.feature: - Tomorrow more contintens will be added to Guess the Flag.

notes.title: Get Better With A Friend and the 2024 Sketchbook together
notes.content:
Added the 2024 Sketchbook a couple of days ago and now you can get it together within a bundle! 20% off on the total price (including ongoing discounts). 

The 2024 Sketchbook is a PDF of photos containing all the pages of the assets made in 2024 for Better WIth A Friend. Some drawings for upcoming games, some sketches that will never be used and the drawings that you can already see in the game. 

Thank you everyone for the support the past year and I will still be adding new content this year!

Geert

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990659/e5451611d949ac7690164802e313b9f4c3948c62.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Last content update of the year! Trivia questions added about the year 2024 to close it off. Do you know more than your friend about what happened? The quiz will be available until the end of January so make sure to best your friend before that!

Thank you everyone that supports Better With A Friend and new additions will be made in 2025!

Happy holidays!

- Geert

notes.title: Game Added: Checkers
notes.content:
Added the first board game to Better With A Friend! Play Checkers against each other while on the road!

[previewyoutube=wjHj4wD0od8;full][/previewyoutube]

Better With A Friend is a side project that I work on between my different freelance jobs. Just adding small games that I can play while on the road with others. Feel free to reach out on X/Twitter if you think a game should be added and I will consider it!
